objects.description: During [C0027](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0027), [Scattered Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1015) exploited CVE-2021-35464 in the ForgeRock Open Access Management (OpenAM) application server to gain initial access.(Citation: Crowdstrike TELCO BPO Campaign December 2022)
